name: loomtracer-context
description: Consult, verify, and contest Loomtracer decisions from Codex by description, never by id, through the deterministic local CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Consult past decisions before you change something.
interface.longDescription: Installs the loomtracer-context skill and CLI-only command scripts. The skill teaches Codex when to check Loomtracer for standing decisions before touching a module, verify whether an old decision still holds, push back (disagree), move on (supersede) — asking first whether the disagreement is with the decision or with a premise it rests on — say what a decision rests on (ground), or say it still holds after something it rests on changed (reaffirm) by description — never by guessing an id.
defaultPrompt: What should I know before I touch this file?
What did we decide about X?
